description: claude-code-router (self-hosted Claude Code gateway, Anthropic protocol) — Fable 5 (the Claude Code model) codes on pro, Sonnet 5 carries the high-traffic standard tier, Opus 5 judges on max, Haiku 4.5 explores on flash. All Claude models accept images and PDFs — vision uses Sonnet 5 for balanced quality. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_ROUTER_BASE_URL + CLAUDE_CODE_ROUTER_API_KEY environment variables.
